integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a locked-off static shot of a sunlit garden koi pond captured from directly above, opening on the exact composition of Picture 1: three clusters of green lotus leaves on the left, at top center, and at the upper right, a pink lotus bud at the top edge, a gray granite rock along the bottom-right edge, pale pink petals floating on the water, a bright sunlight reflection in the upper-center water, and five koi in their opening arrangement. The camera holds perfectly still for the whole shot; only the fish and the water surface move. Exactly five koi swim in slow, unhurried arcs and no koi appears, disappears, or changes markings. The large red-and-white Kohaku at center-right glides in a wide clockwise arc through the open green water toward the lower center, its body uncurling from its slight S-shape and re-curving as it turns back. The solid orange koi below it cruises a short loop along the bottom edge and swings back up toward the right. The red-and-white koi near the top center drifts slightly downward, turns around, and noses back up toward the lily pads. The half-hidden red-and-white koi inside the upper-right lotus leaves and the red-and-white koi tucked beneath the left lotus leaves barely move, only fanning their fins and swaying in place. During the final two seconds the water gradually calms and every koi decelerates, and each fish glides back into its exact starting position, heading, and body posture, so the ripples fade and the closing frame settles into the exact positions, spacing, lighting, and composition established by Picture 2, which is identical to Picture 1.

overall_soundscape: Water laps gently against the granite rock while koi fins make soft, rhythmic splashes and occasional faint gulps at the surface under a quiet garden ambience.
